title: Read the supplied event loop
description: You can follow the ready and sleeping queues without treating sequential delegation as parallel tasks.

steps.description: Future stores a result, completion flag, and callbacks. The later demonstration defines this class without creating a Future.
SimpleEventLoop stores ready generator-value pairs and sleeping generator entries. run creates the root generator and queues it.
The loop moves eligible sleeping entries to ready. It resumes one generator with send and records a sleep signal when one is yielded.
sleep yields a signal tuple. fake_io_task delegates to that generator between its starting and completion messages.

steps.question: Does main_coro start task_B before task_A completes?
steps.answer: No. Its first yield from completes before the second begins.

steps.description: The supplied output shows task_A starting and completing, then task_B starting and completing, followed by all tasks done.
